technical.summary: Strong short-term bullish technicals with price above key moving averages and positive momentum indicators, but extreme overbought conditions on RSI-9 and weak long-term trend structure present meaningful pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: PM shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 85 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed small trades by junior members; broad market neutral sentiment with slight bearish bias (47% bearish vs 25% bullish) offers neither clear opportunity nor warning.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (268) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 85 days poses minimal near-term event risk but macro environment is highly unfavourable for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and RSI-9 extreme overbought suggests strong short-term momentum continuation toward resistance at 81.81.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI-9 overbought (80.3), weak long-term trend (EMA 50/200 not bullish), zero fundamental conviction, macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 268), and below-average volume create high pullback risk with no smart money or insider support.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows short-term bullish structure with price above major moving averages and supertrend confirmation, but entry occurs at extreme RSI overbought (80.3) near resistance with weak long-term trend structure.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment in crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 268) combined with extreme overbought technicals and zero fundamental/smart money conviction creates high probability of sharp pullback before any meaningful upside.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias despite technical strength
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding PM with 43 open Consumer Staples positions (11% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further; skip entry to avoid over-concentration in unfavourable macro.
